# Dr Tejas Pradhan's Dental Clinic

Shop No. A-19, Aareshwar Society, Opp. Dheeraj Darshan, Kokan Nagar Road, Near Kokan Hospital, Jogeshwari East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400060. Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–21:00, closed Sunday. ## Treatments

- [Root canal treatment](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/root-canal.html): Root canal treatment removes infected or inflamed pulp from inside a tooth, cleans and seals the canals, and saves the tooth from extraction.
- [Clear aligners](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/clear-aligners.html): Clear aligners are thin, removable plastic trays that move teeth gradually into place.
- [Braces](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/braces.html): Braces use brackets and wires to straighten teeth and correct the bite.
- [Dental implants](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/dental-implants.html): A dental implant is a small titanium post placed in the jawbone to replace a missing tooth root.
- [Tooth extraction and wisdom teeth](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/tooth-extraction.html): Dr Tejas Pradhan's Dental Clinic in Jogeshwari East carries out routine and surgical tooth extractions, including wisdom teeth, under local anaesthesia after an X-ray.
- [Scaling and teeth cleaning](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/scaling-cleaning.html): Scaling and polishing remove tartar, plaque and stains that brushing cannot.
- [Crowns and bridges](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/crowns-bridges.html): A crown is a cap that covers and protects a damaged tooth.
- [Dentures](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/dentures.html): Dentures are removable replacements for missing teeth.
- [Teeth whitening](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/teeth-whitening.html): Teeth whitening lightens the natural colour of teeth under a dentist's supervision.
- [Tooth-coloured fillings](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/fillings.html): Tooth-coloured composite fillings repair cavities and small chips and blend with your natural teeth.
- [Children's dentistry](https://tejas200567.github.io/tejas-dental/childrens-dentistry.html): Dr Tejas Pradhan's Dental Clinic in Jogeshwari East sees children for check-ups, fillings and preventive care, in a calm and friendly setting for families.
